overall_assessment: USN extraction is good: all 8 random controls hold the full plan for the right course, year and semester, with no uncaptured page text and no wrong-page or empty cases. Only low-severity noise remains: a table of contents repeating the headings, and Leganto reading-list artefacts with glued type labels and repeated list titles.

findings.description: Every plan contains a table-of-contents block (Innholdsfortegnelse followed by the list of section headings, including 'Emnet inngår i følgende studier') before the real content. This is navigation, not plan text, and it duplicates every heading in the text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: shadow_dom strategy takes the whole plan component text, including the TOC element.
findings.suggested_fix: In the usn post_fn, drop the block from the 'Innholdsfortegnelse' line up to the second occurrence of 'Faglig innhold i emnet', or exclude the TOC element in the shadow DOM extraction.

findings.evidence: Click to view interactive reading list in LegantoBøker
findings.description: The Leganto reading list is glued: the widget label runs into the next heading ('LegantoBøker', 'LegantoModul 6.1'), and item type labels run into titles ('BookOppdag naturen...', 'Book ChapterGode skrivestrategier', 'ArticleFive Decades...'). Widget text ('Click to view interactive reading list in Leganto', 'View online', 'In compendium') is UI boilerplate.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Leganto web component renders inline spans without separators, so text extraction concatenates them.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert a newline after known Leganto type labels (Book, Book Chapter, Article, Electronic Article, Website, Government Document, Journal, Other) and after 'Leganto', and drop the 'Click to view interactive reading list in Leganto', 'View online' lines.

findings.description: The reading-list section starts with one title per campus or list version, with repeats (Drammen twice, Notodden twice in MG2NA2). These are list names, not literature, and repeat the same block.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Several Leganto list headers (one per campus) are rendered in the page and all captured.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop lines before the Leganto 'Click to view' label in the Litteratur section, or collapse them to unique values.
